{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for heavier rock and metal right now, so Adele's pop ballads do not fit my mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal pop sound is far from the heavier albums I have been playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: All Over the World - The Very Best of Electric Light Orchestra; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic orchestral rock is less heavy than what I want this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adele's soulful pop does not match my current interest in aggressive guitars and heavier vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fm - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot confidently identify this release from the title, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blackstar; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Bowie's experimental art rock is interesting, but I want a more direct heavy rock or metal listen right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Year Zero; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Nine Inch Nails' abrasive industrial sound feels close enough to my heavier listening to make this worth trying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Abbey Road; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not in the mood for classic melodic rock when my recent listening has leaned toward metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Late Registration       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Hip-hop does not fit the guitar-driven music I want on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rock or Bust; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: AC/DC's driving riffs fit my hard rock interests, even if I often prefer something heavier."}
